name: The Door free youth membership (jobs, school, health, housing help)
what_you_do: A free youth center in Manhattan and the Bronx. The page names housing, health care, legal help and art programs. Extra drop-in hours are open for young people without stable housing.
who_can_apply: Anyone ages 12 to 24. No documents are needed. Some programs have their own age rules.
pay_detail: Joining is free. Some job training programs pay stipends (see the CUT Culinary card).
how_to_apply: Go to 555 Broome Street, Manhattan, Monday to Friday 2:00 to 5:30 pm (extra hours 10:00 am to 2:00 pm for urgent needs and for youth without stable housing). Or call 212-941-9090 or email membership@door.org.
notes: The Door also has a Bronx drop-in center for runaway and homeless youth. Ask staff for details, because ages for it are not stated. Some job training programs have their own age rules, so ask staff.
